front-test: #TEST de PRUEBAAAAAAAAAAAAA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./apps/frontend
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '22'
        cahche: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Run unit tests with coverage
      run: npx tsc --noEmit

    - name: Upload coverage report
      if: always()
      uses: action/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: coverage-report
        path: coverage/
        retention-days: 7

  front-build: #BUILD
    name: Producton Build for frontend
    needs: front-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cahche: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
    
      - name: App-front Build
        run: npm run build:ci
      
      - name: Save App-Front on Dist
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-build
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7
